Launch brokerer Space Flight Laboratory (UTIAS-SFL)
Oneliner

Tether deployment to test deorbiting method.
Description

The main payload is an 450 m long electrodynamic tether for deorbiting the satellite. The tether is deployed using a novel yo-yo system, greatly simplifying construction and deployment. A calibrated test transmitter is flown as secondary payload.
